svg.data-steps: ["A team sends a message to a user","The team reads the message status","A user changes channel settings","The provider is down: the message waits and retries"]
svg.title: High-level design of the notification service, built one scenario at a time
svg.desc: A team sends a message through the API to a queue, where it counts as accepted; senders read the queue and deliver through an external provider. The sender writes the status to the message store, and the team reads it through the API. A user saves channel settings through a settings service to a settings store; senders read a copy refreshed every minute. When the provider is down, the message waits in the queue and is retried with backoff. Next to each store, its data: the queue keeps the message for 7 days; the messages table is keyed by message_id and has a status; settings are a key-value pair by user_id.
